papers.title_en: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
papers.authors: Cheng-Kuang Chang, Alexander H. Liu, Brian Kingsbury, Hilde Kuehne, Rogerio Feris, Samuel Thomas, James Glass, Kai-Wei Chang
papers.evidence: 提出D2框架将半双工SLM转换为支持同时听说的全双工SLM
papers.tldr: 全双工口语模型虽支持同时听说但通用能力落后于半双工模型。本文提出D2框架，通过对音频编码器无解码器表示蒸馏以适应流式，并通过监督微调学习全双工交互，从而将预训练半双工骨干转化为高能力全双工模型。在Qwen3-Omni和LLaMA-Omni 2上实验，12.5Hz更新率下，Qwen3-Omni-D2实现99.2%轮流成功、521ms延迟、99.5%打断成功和70.1 VoiceBench的SOTA。该工作显著提升了全双工模型的通用能力。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

papers.title_en: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
papers.authors: Chen Chen, Pin-Jui Ku, Ankita Pasad, Ante Jukić, Zhehuai Chen, Boris Ginsburg
papers.evidence: 基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言模型
papers.tldr: 现代全双工口语模型常将说话时机与内容压缩在单一自回归时间线，限制智能与响应速度。Diffuplex通过离散扩散分离训练目标，在思考模式下每前向步生成13.0 token、平均1872 token/s，超越前沿自回归模型；无思考模式保持首音频延迟的同时提升语言智能。该模型在推理中并行扩散生成与细化回复，使语义计算不再受音频帧率限制，为实时口语智能体建立新范式。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

papers.title_en: Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures
papers.authors: Siyin Wang, Wenyi Yu, Terumi Chiba, Xianzhao Chen, Xiaohai Tian, Jun Zhang, Lu Lu, Chao Zhang
papers.evidence: 端到端全双工对话模型，同时优化语音交互和流式手势表情生成
papers.tldr: 面对面对话需协调语音、手势与表情，现有模型多仅关注言语响应。ELLSA 2提出端到端全双工对话模型，通过分块自回归合成与听/说状态分离，实现说话与沉默时的连续非言语生成。引入上下文语义调用与模板引导，提升手势语义准确性。实验表明该模型在对话手势与表情指标上优于级联基线，语义模板显著改善手势质量，推动对话建模向多模态协调交互发展。
papers.abstract_en: Human face-to-face conversation requires coordinating speech, gestures and expressions across both speaking and listening. We present ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation. An autoregressive, chunk-wise synthesizer combines pretrained acoustic features with distinct listening and speaking hidden states from the dialogue backbone and speech synthesizer, enabling continuous non-verbal generation even when the model is verbally silent. To translate dialogue understanding into vivid semantic gestures, we introduce contextual semantic calls and template guidance, separating whether to invoke an available semantic gesture from how to realize it. We also establish a curated data and evaluation pipeline for dialog-aware co-speech gesture generation and investigate reference-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as automatic judges. Experiments show that ELLSA 2 remains highly competitive with open-source full-duplex speech interaction models and outperforms cascaded baselines across dialog-aware gesture and expression metrics. Semantic template guidance further significantly improves semantic gesture quality. Strong system-level correlations with human judgments support these reference-based scores as useful preliminary metrics for full-duplex and semantic gesture assessment. Together, these results advance dialogue modeling from spoken responses toward coordinated multimodal interaction.

papers.title_en: DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?
papers.authors: Jiaheng Dong, Shihong Tan, Gongping Huang, Jean Honorio, Abhirup Ghosh, Ting Dang
papers.evidence: 评估端到端全双工口语语言模型的交互行动
papers.tldr: 全双工口语语言模型需实时决定交互动作，但现有基准缺乏动作级结构化评估、常只衡量动作出现而非成功。DuplexAct 提出三级动作分类，涵盖8种动作与24种条件，并定义立即执行和后续跟进来度量成功。该基准含4691个测试实例（其中2531个来自真实录音），覆盖闲聊、会议、客服和面试等场景。它为系统评估端到端全双工模型的交互参与能力提供了真实、结构化的框架。
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

papers.title_en: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
papers.evidence: 针对全双工语音系统中说话权控制的基准，包含话轮结束与打断检测
papers.tldr: 全双工语音系统需在多说话人重叠中判断何时进入、保持或放弃对话地板，但评估缺乏对多方真正地板转换的受控测试。提出MPTB基准，含240个合成通道分离对话，覆盖2至5人、6种交互，用事件条件标注评估EOT和INT两个任务。EOT召回82.5%-92.6%但假阳性4.3%-11.8%；INT检测及五个全双工智能体选择性中断接近随机，Gemini对97.7%回话让出而MiniCPM仅1.4%真实中断。该基准确立选择性地板控制为多方语音交互未解决的独特挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.

papers.title_en: Reference-Guided Turn-Taking Style Transfer for Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Yang Xiao, Jack Sun, Chak Sun, Brick Li, Sam
papers.evidence: 识别主导向量以控制全双工语音语言模型的轮流发言风格
papers.tldr: 全双工口语语言模型每帧决定是否发言，其对话风格通常固定于权重，现有控制难以调整发言量。本文识别出晚期层残差流中的单一方向，即主动权向量，无需训练即可从模型自身对话提取。该方向可提前800毫秒预判发言，缩放后可大幅改变发言比例，并能用简短录音迁移特定说话者的轮流风格。这表明轮流风格并非固化于权重，而是可读取、调整和个性化校准的方向。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken language models decide at every frame whether to take the floor, defining a conversational personality -- yet each set of weights encodes exactly one, which human speakers bracket rather than share. Existing controls mostly act from outside; none identifies the quantity that sets how much the model speaks. We identify it: a single late-layer residual-stream direction, the initiative vector, extracted from the model's own conversations without training or annotation. The same direction reads the decision, anticipating onsets up to 800 ms ahead, and shifts it: scaled during generation, it moves speech ratio from 6-12% to 42-61% (no steering: 21-30%), consistently across conversations, weights, and corpora. A short reference recording suffices to transfer a speaker's turn-taking style to the model, and the transfer is reference-specific: swapping in another speaker's reference worsens the match in 93-98% of cases, whereas the best uniform dose is indistinguishable from no steering. Turn-taking style is not frozen into the weights but a direction that can be read, shifted, and calibrated per person. Audio examples are available at https://elpsykongloo.github.io/initiative-vector/.

papers.title_en: VoxTurn: Answering Several Turn-Taking Questions in One Pass with One Model
papers.evidence: VoxTurn为全双工语音代理处理轮流发言决策
papers.tldr: 语音代理需在用户沉默时判断是否结束轮次，过早打断、过晚迟缓，开放检测器在多语言中停顿处误判严重。VoxTurn 是0.8B语音LLM，将相关决策转为多选题，通过块隔离注意力一次前向回答任意问题组合。英语假截断率11.5%，14语言平均19.9%为开放模型最低，单次决策仅8.3ms。模型与插件已发布，可直接集成到 Pipecat/LiveKit 降低截断。
papers.abstract_en: A cascaded voice agent must decide, throughout each silence of its user, whether the user has finished their turn: answering too early cuts the user off, answering too late makes the agent slow. It often needs related decisions too: will the user soon go on, is speech during its own turn an interruption or a backchannel, is a sound speech at all. With open detectors, each extra decision costs another model or another call, and on the 14-language eot-bench they cut users off in more than a quarter of mid-turn pauses. Because they are trained on segmented utterances, this mismatch is the largest single source of error. We present VoxTurn, a 0.8B speech LLM that casts these decisions as multiple-choice questions, scores the hidden state of each option, and answers any set of them in one forward pass with a block-isolating attention mask, exactly as if asked one at a time. Trained on real conversational pauses with labels derived from their timing, and re-queried while a silence lasts, VoxTurn reaches 11.5% false cut-offs in English at a 300 ms latency budget, comparable to two commercial detectors, and a 14-language mean of 19.9%, the lowest among open models, at 8.3 ms per decision. In Pipecat and LiveKit it cuts off 17% and 9% of turns, and it ranks fifth of 24 in TurnBench end-of-turn detection without any TurnBench training data. The model, code and framework plugins are released.

papers.title_en: JAVIS: Joint Audio-Visual Interaction and Streaming for Real-Time Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Junseok Ahn, Jaehyun Park, Jeongsoo Choi, Joon Son Chung, Ji-Hoon Kim
papers.evidence: 端到端流式音视频对话代理框架，支持实时自然交互
papers.tldr: 现有对话系统多聚焦文本或语音，忽略视觉反馈，难以实现自然多模态交互。JAVIS提出端到端流式框架，通过共享大语言模型上的联合精炼头生成统一音视频表示，并分别送入语音与面部专用流式分支进行同步生成，避免了中间瓶颈。在自建的334小时合成数据JAVIS-Syn上训练后，该模型初始延迟比强基线降低约200倍，唇同步和面部表情适当性均显著优于基线。这项工作为实时音视频对话代理提供了高效同步的端到端解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Human communication is inherently multimodal, conveying intent not only through linguistic and vocal cues but also through visual signals. However, existing conversational systems have mainly focused on text or speech, leaving out the visual feedback that is essential for natural interaction. In this paper, we propose JAVIS, an end-to-end streaming framework for real-time audio-visual conversational agents. Our key idea is to let the voice and the face speak from a single representation. On top of a shared LLM, a Joint Refined Head produces a unified audio-visual representation, which is fed into dedicated streaming branches for speech and face generation. This end-to-end design avoids intermediate bottlenecks, enabling real-time generation while keeping speech and face tightly synchronized. In addition, we present JAVIS-Syn, a 334-hour synthetic corpus designed to address the lack of expressive audio-visual dialogue data, covering emotionally rich multi-turn conversations and assistant-style exchanges. Experiments show that JAVIS achieves approximately 200$\times$ lower initial latency than a strong baseline, while outperforming baselines in lip synchronization and facial expression appropriateness.

papers.title_en: Jarvis: Coordination Deserves a Brain of Its Own in Agentic Interactive Models
papers.authors: Yuxiang Wang, Shengbo Cai, Zhixian Zhao, Yingda Shen, Yuancheng Wang, Xueyao Zhang, Liqiang Zhang, Teddy Sun, Steve Yves, Zhizheng Wu
papers.evidence: 用于交互模型的全双工对话协调框架
papers.tldr: 交互式模型把复杂推理交给后台慢脑，前端实时对话，但用户中途修改请求会让在途任务与结果过时，前端与后端各看一半，缺乏协调。Jarvis引入一个同时观察对话与活任务的协调脑，由JEV决策模型判断、代码按版本化任务记录强制执行，并在计划执行前、结果播报前后反复校验。在固定前后端条件下，以Jarvis替换Qwen Audio Agent使tau-Voice成功率提升六倍多，并在Full-Duplex-Bench v3上以9B前端达到69% Pass1，超过GPT-Realtime的60%。这表明协调机制与模型能力同等重要。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive models increasingly hand complex reasoning and tool use to a slow brain in the background, leaving a realtime front model free to sustain full-duplex dialogue. Yet the user may refine, cancel or replace a request while its task runs, so a plan or result that made sense a moment ago goes stale. Each new utterance must therefore be read against the work in flight, but the front model follows only the conversation and the back end sees only its own task. Coordination deserves a brain of its own, one that sees both. We introduce Jarvis, a coordination harness where models judge and code enforces. Its typed decision model, JEV, reads each turn against the live tasks and picks among operations built from a versioned task record. Code checks every choice against the current state before applying it, so no decision can act on a task version the user has replaced. Jarvis also rechecks plans before they execute and results before they are spoken, and counts an answer as delivered only once the user has heard it in full. We build two instances of this design. Jarvis-Audio runs unchanged on three full-duplex speech models. Jarvis-Omni adds vision and rechecks the evidence behind an answer before and during playback, since a scene can change while nobody speaks. With the front model and back end held fixed, replacing Qwen Audio Agent with Jarvis raises tau-Voice task success more than sixfold, from 29 to 192 of 278 tasks, and the gains hold on every benchmark and front model. Against published systems, Jarvis-Audio reaches 69% Pass1 on Full-Duplex-Bench v3 with an open 9B front model, versus 60% for GPT-Realtime. These results suggest that how the two brains are coordinated matters as much as how strong they are.

papers.title_en: Omni-Modal LLMs Know More Than They Say
papers.authors: Na Min An, Taekyung Kim, Jaemyung Yu, Hyunjung Shim, Dongyoon Han
papers.evidence: 改善全模态大模型对齐以表达非文本信息
papers.tldr: 全模态大模型（Omni-LLMs）能感知非文本模态，却常无法用语言表达相关知识，即“知而不言”。为此提出令牌级模态对齐（TMA）度量，发现非文本模态对齐与注意力较弱。进而设计OmniCatalyst，采用感知-推理策略，用自生成文本补充原始输入，提升非文本知识可及性。在7个模型上平均提升7.29%，模态偏好更均衡，证明改善对齐能增强全模态表达。
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) extend LLMs to process heterogeneous modalities (e.g., vision, audio, and IMU signals) alongside language, enabling a broader range of multimodal tasks. Yet we find that these models often fail to express information from non-textual modalities even when they perceive it correctly. We term this disconnect knows-but-cannot-say. To investigate this phenomenon, we introduce Token-level Modality Alignment (TMA), which measures the alignment between individual modality representations and response representations. Our analysis shows that non-textual representations are less aligned with response tokens and receive less attention than textual representations, suggesting a potential explanation for uneven modality preferences. Motivated by these findings, we propose OmniCatalyst, a simple perceive $\rightarrow$ infer strategy that complements the original modality inputs with self-generated text, making non-textual knowledge more accessible. Across seven Omni-LLMs, OmniCatalyst consistently improves performance (+7.29%) and yields more balanced modality preferences, with further gains from diverse training strategies. Further analysis demonstrates that the knowledge extraction phases increase TMA, suggesting that improved alignment makes non-textual information more accessible during response generation. In summary, our findings uncover how Omni-LLMs can better express modality knowledge through language. Our code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/OmniLLM.

papers.title_en: Distilling Text LMs into Speech-to-Speech LMs by Matching Internal Text Predictions
papers.authors: Ju-Chieh Chou, Jiawei Zhou, Karen Livescu
papers.evidence: 通过从文本LM蒸馏的语音到语音预训练方法支持语音交互智能体
papers.tldr: 文本语言模型具备广泛语言与事实能力，但仅从语音学习难以获得可比能力。本文提出语音到语音预训练方法，创建内部文本预测接口，使模型先消费无转录语音上下文，随后预测文本并逐词引导后续语音生成，同时保持纯语音输入输出。该接口可直接从基础文本LM蒸馏，实现知识迁移。在匹配训练条件下，生成困惑度显著低于纯语音和交错语音文本模型，接近文本引导模型，且蒸馏提升文本与语音评估下的事实性能，首次验证文本LM蒸馏到语音到语音LM的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Text language models (LMs) acquire broad linguistic and factual capabilities through large-scale pretraining, while comparable capabilities remain difficult to learn from speech alone. Recent work has shown that knowledge distillation from pretrained text LMs offers a promising way to transfer their linguistic and factual capabilities to speech models. However, existing distillation approaches have largely focused on speech-input, text-output models. This idea has yet to be explored for {\it speech-to-speech} models, which operate on both speech input and speech output. In this work we introduce a speech-to-speech pretraining method that creates an internal text interface for knowledge transfer while preserving the speech-only input and output. The model first consumes speech context without its transcription, switches to text prediction, and then uses the predicted text to lead future speech generation word by word. It also provides an interface for knowledge distillation: the internal text predictions can be directly distilled from the base text LM. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of text LM distillation to a speech-to-speech LM. Under matched training conditions, the proposed sequence construction substantially improves the generative perplexity of spoken continuations over speech-only and interleaved speech-text models, approaching the performance of a text-leading inner-monologue model with external ASR prompt transcription. More importantly, distillation improves factual performance under both text and speech evaluation, indicating better retention of knowledge from the base text language model.

papers.title_en: Speaking Longer Than Learned: Training-Free Long-Form Generation for Full-Stream Text-to-Speech
papers.authors: Jeseung Lim, Jiseong Woo, Heeseung Kim
papers.evidence: 全流式TTS无训练长文本生成，支撑实时对话低延迟语音合成
papers.tldr: 全流式文本到语音模型虽支持低延迟个性化合成，但超出训练长度的长形式生成仍然退化。VoXtream2 通过周期丢弃旧上下文保留声学提示，无法防止发音准确率在训练范围末端下降和说话人相似度衰退，根因是模型操作的绝对位置范围。本文提出缩小注意力窗口和增强声学提示注意力两种无需训练修改。实验表明二者互补，能在长生成中保持发音准确率、说话人相似度和自然度。
papers.abstract_en: Recent full-stream text-to-speech (TTS) models enable low-latency personalized synthesis as input text arrives. However, sustaining generation beyond the lengths seen during training without additional training remains largely unexplored. We systematically analyze VoXtream2, which extends generation by periodically discarding past context while retaining the acoustic prompt. We find that this strategy does not prevent degradation: pronunciation accuracy deteriorates near the end of the training range due to the range of positions in which the model operates rather than the loss of past context, while speaker similarity gradually declines throughout generation. Based on these findings, we propose two training-free modifications that reduce the attention window and strengthen attention to the acoustic prompt. Experiments show that these modifications preserve pronunciation accuracy and speaker similarity throughout long-form generation while retaining the naturalness of the original model. Ablations further show complementary effects of the two modifications.

papers.title_en: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.authors: Yingzhuo Deng, Chong Li, Bingxin Liu, Yi Shu, Tianyu Peng, Can Xie, Siyao Song, Shuo Ren, Jiajun Zhang
papers.evidence: 提出CoSTA压缩语音令牌以提升口语对话模型效率，降低推理延迟
papers.tldr: 语音对话模型通常共享语音token空间用于生成与合成导致长自回归序列和高推理成本。CoSTA提出兼容性保持的后处理框架解耦生成与合成token空间通过均值初始化词汇扩展发音适应和对话适应引入压缩表示并在合成前确定性扩展回原始空间。在双语基准上取得约1.7倍生成速度更低全响应延迟和更高吞吐同时保持响应质量。该框架支持跨架构迁移并与低速率tokenization互补提升交互持续性。
papers.abstract_en: Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling. To address this limitation, we propose CoSTA, a compatibility-preserving post-hoc framework that decouples generation and synthesis token spaces while retaining the original speech tokenizer and decoder. CoSTA extends the generation token space with compressed representations via mean-initialized vocabulary extension, pronunciation adaptation, and dialogue adaptation, followed by deterministic expansion back to the original speech-token space before synthesis. On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately $1.7\times$ expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput while preserving response quality. Analyses show more sustained interaction under limited budgets and a practical trade-off among compression, decoding efficiency, and quality. Further experiments demonstrate cross-architecture transfer and complementarity to low-rate tokenization.

papers.title_en: Stop Training Against Soft Users: Mentalized Adversarial Self-Play for Proactive Dialogue
papers.authors: Zanwu Liu, Dan Zhang, Xiaodi Wang, Yongbo Mao, Xiaoyang Guo, Yonglin Wu, Peiyue Jiang, Yangyang Wei, Zecheng Lin
papers.evidence: 心理化对抗自博弈用于主动对话，直接解决多轮对话管理
papers.tldr: 现有主动对话代理多在过于顺从的模拟器上训练评估，存在软用户偏差，高模拟成功率未必反映稳健对话能力。本文提出 MASP，将主动对话建模为部分可观察博弈，用 BDI 潜在状态表示用户心理状态，并交替自博弈更新系统与用户策略。在多个基准上，MASP 相比 SFT 和 Planner-only 显著提高成功率与理性约束成功率，降低平均轮数，对强硬用户表现更佳。该方法把对理性抵抗的稳健性转化为训练目标，而非仅作为评估条件。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive dialogue agents must guide multi-turn interactions toward task goals while adapting to users whose intentions and attitudes evolve. Existing planners improve system side action selection through search, learned policies, or user aware planning, but are often trained and evaluated against fixed or overly compliant simulators; as a result, high simulated success can reflect soft user bias rather than robust dialogue ability. We introduce MASP, a Mentalized Adversarial Self Play framework that treats proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between a system and a rationally resisting user. MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self play updates for the system and user policies. This turns robustness to rational resistance into a training objective rather than only an evaluation condition. Across diverse proactive dialogue benchmarks, compared with the widely used SFT and Planner-only approaches, MASP substantially improves success rate (SR) and rationality constrained success (RCSR), reduces average turns (AT), and performs better against hard users who make the task goal more difficult to achieve.

papers.title_en: TEM: Temporal State Tracking Memory for Large Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Pengfeng Song, Yunkai Zhuang, Liye Shi
papers.evidence: 代理的时间状态跟踪记忆支持跨对话信息变化下的多轮对话管理
papers.tldr: 大模型代理记忆需跟踪随时间变化的事实，同一属性新旧值对不同问题均有价值。提出无训练框架TEM，将事实保存为带来源的版本化记录，检索后按来源顺序排列并标注历史状态，结合事件记忆与对话细节作为证据。在多个数据集上，关键实体命中率达75.71-97.62%，添加历史标签使命中率提升17.14-55.95个百分点，证据比会话感知RAG减少约一半。结果表明保留事实版本并暴露时间状态可显著提升回答反复更新信息问题的能力。
papers.abstract_en: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.

papers.title_en: DriftTTS: One-stage Single Step Text-to-Speech via Generative Drifting
papers.authors: Jaehyun Ahn, Dohyun Kim, Heeseung Kim
papers.evidence: 生成漂移单步TTS，降低语音合成延迟
papers.tldr: 基于得分匹配与流匹配的TTS需多次调用解码器，合成较慢。现有降次方法依赖多步教师蒸馏或预训练模型加阶段，未探索免预训练的单步TTS。DriftTTS提出生成漂移目标，把迭代采样从推理移入训练，并用分段漂移处理变长语音。在LJSpeech上，DriftTTS单次解码即可达到Matcha-TTS与RapFlow-TTS的多步质量、速度更快，首次将生成漂移用于TTS。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-speech models built on score matching and flow matching produce natural speech, but only by calling the decoder many times, which makes synthesis slow. Existing ways to cut the number of calls either distill from a multi-step teacher or add a stage on top of a pretrained model, leaving single-step TTS without a pretrained TTS model unexplored. We question whether pretraining a TTS model is necessary, and propose DriftTTS, which adopts generative drifting, an objective that moves iterative sampling from inference into training. Drifting assumes samples of fixed shape, whereas speech has variable length; we address this issue with segment drifting. On LJSpeech, DriftTTS matches the multi-step quality of Matcha-TTS and RapFlow-TTS in a single decoder call, while being faster. To our knowledge, this is the first application of generative drifting to text-to-speech.

papers.title_en: PhonoVoxtLM: Exploring Single-Codebook Phonological Tokens for Speech Understanding and Generation
papers.authors: Mingrui Liang, Kentaro Onda, Shinji Watanabe
papers.evidence: 单码本音系token统一语音理解与生成，是口语对话模型的关键
papers.tldr: 语音语言模型统一理解和生成时常面临语音token表示权衡。PhonoVoxtLM基于VoxtLM框架，采用单码本语音token，联合训练语音识别与重合成，保留语言内容和韵律信息。在多种训练数据规模下，该模型理解与生成性能均超越HuBERT基线；与WavLM token对比虽暴露识别与合成权衡，但整体更优。扩展到口语问答后，微调回放使回答性能进一步提升并保持原任务优势。这表明单码本语音表示是统一多任务语音建模的实用有效选择。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how speech token representations can support both understanding and generation within a unified speech language model. We present PhonoVoxtLM, built on the existing VoxtLM framework using phonological tokens designed to retain linguistic content and prosodic information. The existing tokenizer is jointly trained for speech recognition and resynthesis. Its single-codebook units serve as both speech inputs and generation targets, without additional speech-token prediction modules. Experiments show improvements over HuBERT-based baselines across understanding and generation under different training-data scales. Further comparisons with WavLM-based tokens reveal trade-offs between recognition and synthesis, highlighting the importance of evaluating shared representations across both capabilities. We further extend the framework to spoken question answering through fine-tuning with replay. The adapted model improves answering performance over similarly adapted HuBERT baselines while retaining advantages on the original speech tasks. Our findings support single-codebook representations designed for both content and prosody as a practical choice for unified multitask speech modeling.

papers.title_en: Soloist: A Generative Model for Blind Voice Separation in the Wild
papers.authors: Chen Yang, ChuFan Yu, Botian Jiang, Jingqi Chen, Wenxuan Wang, Yitian Gong, Zhaoye Fei, Xipeng Qiu
papers.evidence: 从重叠语音中分离出各说话人，可支持全双工系统的打断功能
papers.tldr: 真实世界盲语音分离需从重叠语音、噪声和音乐中恢复个体声音，但孤立源录音监督稀缺。Soloist作为生成式模型，自回归生成个体语音流为音频编解码序列，以混合物为条件，无需目标查询或预定义语音数。两阶段训练结合合成混合物监督分离、真实录音说话人时间线预测和强化学习，用模型评判器奖励语音纯度和内容保留。实验显示其在多说话人重叠、噪声和音乐场景下恢复干净语音，提取歌声音高准确、可懂度高，并能集成到全双工对话流程形成连续说话人轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world voice separation must recover individual voices from overlapping speech, environmental noise, and music, yet isolated source recordings are rarely available for supervision. We introduce Soloist, a generative model for blind voice separation that autoregressively generates individual voice streams as audio-codec sequences conditioned on the mixture, without requiring a target-speaker query or a predefined voice count. We propose a two-stage training paradigm to learn from synthetic mixtures and adapt to real recordings. The first stage combines supervised separation on synthetic mixtures with isolated source targets and an auxiliary task that predicts speaker timelines from real recordings, learning who speaks when from natural acoustics. The second stage applies reinforcement learning to real recordings, with rewards supplied by a model judge that compares candidate separations based on voice purity and content preservation without isolated source targets. Across diverse scenarios, Soloist recovers clean speech from multi-speaker overlap and noisy recordings, and extracts singing vocals from music accompaniment while maintaining relatively high pitch accuracy and intelligibility. On real-world recordings with unknown voice counts, Soloist also separates voices well. Finally, we integrate Soloist into a full-duplex conversation processing pipeline that assembles separated outputs into continuous speaker tracks, demonstrating its practical utility in real conversations.

papers.title_en: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
papers.authors: Adibvafa Fallahpour, Parsa Idehpour, Vignesh Kothapalli, Nikita Mounier, Shirley Wu, Shayan Pardis, Jure Leskovec
papers.evidence: 用于多轮对话管理的记忆系统，存储用户对话和智能体动作
papers.tldr: 冻结大模型难以高效利用超出参数的知识，现有记忆系统在检索与合并信息时产生的上下文冗长且低效。Memorilla将文档集合一次性编码为可重用嵌入，并学习为每个查询生成16个查询相关的记忆令牌，注入输入嵌入空间。在8个基准中5个超越Mem0和MemoRAG，FactKG准确率达84.33%且仅用108分之一的令牌，优于80.43%的全上下文推理。该方法还减少智能体在已探索房间间的徘徊，将平均成功率从18.6%提升至24.2%，为冻结LLM持续积累知识提供有效路径。
papers.abstract_en: Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input embedding space. Using only 16 memory tokens, Memorilla achieves the best performance against baselines including Mem0 and MemoRAG on five of eight benchmarks spanning personalization, long-document and knowledge-intensive question answering. Notably, on FactKG, it reaches 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% with full-context inference, while using 108x fewer tokens to represent the source documents. Furthermore, Memorilla can facilitate continual learning in agentic systems where the document count (the agent's past turns) increases throughout the trajectory. In a TextWorld environment, we show that Memorilla reduces the agent's tendency to wander between rooms it has already explored, and improves its average success rate from 18.6% with full-history in-context learning to 24.2%. Overall, Memorilla aids frozen LLMs in accumulating and using knowledge effectively across long-context interactions and takes a step towards building continually learning AI systems.
